# Architecture Decision Records

An ADR records a decision that affects more than one feature: state management, navigation, data layer, styling, authentication, caching strategy, a significant dependency.

- File name: `NNNN-short-title.md` (four digits, e.g. `0001-use-tanstack-query.md`).
- Template: `.eva/templates/adr.md`.
- Agents may draft ADRs with `Status: proposed`; a developer changes it to `accepted` or `rejected`.
- Accepted ADRs are not re-discussed in feature plans. To change one, write a new ADR that supersedes it.
